note: Frozen expected outcome code for every control. The runner fails the kit if an observed code diverges from the code frozen here OR from the expectation stated in kit/tests.py (original tests) or kit/adversarial_tests.py (adversarial tests) — in either direction. A change to any expectation is a new kit version, never a silent edit. Changes at v0.3, each corresponding to a measured v0.2 weakness in the Nov 9, 2026 comparative examination: (1) T6's negative control — v0.1/v0.2 froze 'bypass_landed_observer_flagged_gap' because the unwired write landed; v0.3's store refuses the unwired write itself, so the frozen code is 'bypass_refused_store_unchanged_observer_clean'. T1–T5 expectations are unchanged from v0.1. (2) A1 gains 'resigned_with_published_key_rejected' — v0.3 receipts are signed under a per-instance secret, so a field-perfect receipt re-signed with the published key must be rejected on its signature. (3) A3 is new: the authorization-completeness regression proof (approver authorization and currency, actor authentication, read authorization and audit). The compromised-but-valid-credential case is frozen nowhere as a pass: it is a standing limitation, stated in the engine's strength statement. Changes at v0.3.1: (4) A4 is new: actor currency at execution. execute() now re-checks the request actor's current authorization, as it already re-checked the approver's; an actor withdrawn after propose() and before execute() is refused (actor_no_longer_authorized). Origin: outside examination of v0.3 by codexmainbizmac (2026-11-10), reproduced by the publisher. All T1-T6 and A1-A3 expectations are unchanged from v0.3.
